name: Love Villa: Choose Your Story
source:
Love Island The Game is the story that puts YOU in the heart of the hit reality TV show ‘Love Island’, as seen on ITV and CBS. Create your own interactive stories and choose how you want to play the game.

Love Villa: Choose Your Story lets you play as one of the girls in a fictional season of Love Island and choose how your summer love story unfolds. Will YOU find love? Will you be voted the strongest couple and win? Will you take the prize for yourself or will you choose to share it with your new partner? The choices are entirely up to you!

[From the [url=https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/love-island-the-game/id1280910599]App Store[/url]]
translation:
《爱情岛游戏》的故事让你置身于英国独立电视台 (ITV) 和哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 播出的热门真人秀节目《爱情岛》的中心。创建你自己的互动故事并选择你想要玩游戏的方式。

爱情别墅：选择你的故事让你扮演爱情岛虚构季节中的女孩之一，并选择你的夏季爱情故事如何展开。你会找到爱情吗？你们会被选为最强情侣并获胜吗？你会自己获得奖品还是会选择与你的新伙伴分享？选择完全取决于你！

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/love-island-the-game/id1280910599]App Store[/url]]
